title: The Owner saves, lists, runs and removes lead hunts, and blocks an address, from fw hunt
description: On 10 Nov the Owner chose to add hunts, and the pages they search first, from the CLI (`fw hunt add --link`) and the local app. Today the hunt routes exist in fwd but nothing in fw calls them, and an organizer who replies "no" can only be blocked with a raw API call. fw gains `fw hunt add` (--name, --looking-for, --region, repeatable --area and --link, --every, --max, --build), `fw hunt list`, `fw hunt run <id>`, `fw hunt remove <id>` and `fw hunt block <address or @domain> --reason <text>`. Each goes through fwd with the CLI token, using the existing hunt and do-not-contact routes; fwd's checks stay the only checks. With fwd down each exits non-zero and says fwd is not running. --json prints what fwd answers.
acceptance: With fwd down, fw hunt list exits non-zero and says fwd is not running
fw hunt add saves a hunt with repeated --link and --area, --every, --max and --build; a link fwd refuses saves nothing and exits non-zero
fw hunt list prints the saved hunts, as JSON and as text
fw hunt block adds an address or an @domain to the flow's do-not-contact list; anything else is refused; --reason is required
fw hunt run fires the flow for that hunt; fw hunt remove deletes one
